Activist on Hunger Strike Hospitalized Amidst Protest

Activist Sonam Wangchuk, who was on a hunger strike for 20 days, was taken to Safdarjung Hospital by police. The move occurred as protests by the Cockroach Janta Party intensified, with some outlets reporting he was taken against his wishes. His vital signs were reported as stable.
